rows.en: It seems the Peacemillion has chosen to cooperate with the United Space Force.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: If Commander Misumaru is right, that force is likely the UCE's <pic(1)><cs(3)>Enhanced Corps<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: ...We've all seen for ourselves what the UCE is trying to do.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: I believe the Ra Cailum must follow the right path.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: Captain Bright agrees with me on this. I'd like all of you to come with us.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: <mk(75,-25,6,0,50)><ar(0,6,0,500)>This ship will now move in to support the Peacemillion.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: I'm truly glad that all of you have chosen the same path as us.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: The Gran Garan, which stayed behind on Earth, has also declared its intention to join us.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: So Londo Bell is reborn, then. I'd love to compose a haiku to mark the occasion, but...
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: We still have work left to do. We must stop Duke Dermail.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: A few radicals or not, an indiscriminate attack on a civilian colony is unforgivable.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: Each UCE group, such as the Earth Federation and the Integrated Armed Forces, has agreed.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: I want you to head to Sweetwater at once. I'm counting on you.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: To think that Londo Bell, a gathering of the elite, would actually be defeated...
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?
